// @provenance rule: rule_class
export class Token {}

// @provenance rule: rule_default_function
export default function pays(hours) {
  return hours > 38;
}

// @provenance rule: rule_generator
export function* shifts() {
  yield 1;
}

// @provenance verification: examples
// @provenance rule: rule_test_callback
test("hours above 38", function overtimeExamples() {
  expect(pays(39)).toBe(true);
});

// @provenance verification: examples
// @provenance rule: rule_arrow_test
test("hours above 38", () => {
  expect(pays(39)).toBe(true);
});

// @provenance rule: rule_anonymous_default
export default function () {}

export function namedAfter() {}

export class Clock {
  // @provenance rule: rule_generator_method
  *hours() {
    let total = 0;
    return total;
  }
}

// @provenance rule: rule_let
let first, second;

// @provenance rule: rule_var
var counter = 0;

const pick = ready ?
  // @provenance rule: rule_multiline_ternary
  foo(a) :
  bar;

app.get("/",
  // @provenance rule: rule_handler_argument
  async (req, res) => {
    res.end();
  });

function* keywords() {
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_if
  if (ready) {
  }
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_for
  for (const shift of shifts) {
  }
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_while
  while (ready) {
  }
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_switch
  switch (ready) {
    // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_case
    case (ready): {
    }
  }
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_try
  try {
  }
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_catch
  catch (error) {
  }
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_finally
  finally {
  }
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_do
  do {
  } while (ready);
  if (ready) {
  }
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_else
  else {
  }
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_with
  with (scope) {
  }
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_throw
  throw failure(ready);
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_new
  new Payroll(ready);
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_await
  await pays(ready);
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_yield
  yield pays(ready);
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_typeof
  typeof pays(ready);
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_delete
  delete totals[ready];
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_void
  void pays(ready);
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_super
  super(ready);
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_this
  this.pays(ready);
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_import
  import("./pay");
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_async
  async (ready) => {};
  // @provenance rule: rule_keyword_return
  return pays(ready);
}
